rulingTitle: Git also reports 'not a git repository' when an existing mirror's HEAD is unreadable. A real-git reproduction with HEAD mode 000 caused pruneProjectCode to delete the healthy mirror despite active pin j1.

action.reason: probeMirror (mirror-store.ts:33) maps any 'not a git repository' message to not-a-mirror, but git also prints it when HEAD is unreadable. In that case prune deletes a healthy mirror that still has a live pin. Fix: only return not-a-mirror after independent filesystem checks confirm HEAD, objects and refs are missing; otherwise throw so the mirror is kept. Add a regression test with an unreadable HEAD and an active pin.

rationale: The deletion is irreversible and breaks a live session. The trigger is unlikely, but the fix is small and conservative, so a human should confirm it rather than ship the risk.
